data.name: MinimaxHailuo03ReferenceNode
data.description: Generate video conditioned on reference images, videos, and audio using the MiniMax H3 models. Refer to the references in the prompt by their order: 'Image 1', 'Image 2', 'Video 1', 'Audio 1', and so on.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.ratio
input_details.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

input_details.name: model.reference_images.image_1
input_details.tooltip: Subject or style reference images, referred to in the prompt as 'Image 1'..'Image 9' in connection order. Up to 9 images.

input_details.name: model.reference_videos.video_1
input_details.tooltip: Motion or scene reference videos, referred to in the prompt as 'Video 1'..'Video 3' in connection order. Up to 3 videos, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total.

input_details.name: model.reference_audios.audio_1
input_details.tooltip: Audio references, referred to in the prompt as 'Audio 1'..'Audio 3' in connection order. Up to 3 clips, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total. Cannot be used without a reference image or video.

input_details.name: model.prompt_expansion_mode
input_details.tooltip: How much effort is spent rewriting the prompt before generation.

input_details.name: model.reference_detail
input_details.tooltip: Detail level at which reference images are sent. 'high' sends them at the largest size the model uses (up to a 2048 pixel short side); 'standard' downsizes them to at most 2048x1024 to reduce the reference cost.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Random seed. The same request with the same seed gives similar, but not guaranteed identical, results.

input_details.name: watermark
input_details.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.
